title: How to set global monthly batch numbering in ERPNext”

posts.name: Innovatrontechnologies
posts.cooked:
I want to set up a Batch Number Series with the following format: .

For example, for Item with Standard Code 70125, the first batch of August should be 701250801. The second batch in the same month could be for a different item, say Standard Code 8091, which should be 80910802.

The sequence (NN) should be global across all items for a given month (not item-wise). At the start of each new month, the sequence should reset back to 01.

So, for August (08), if I create 20 batches across different products like Endopsy, EVA Gloves, etc., the last batch ID should end with 20. From September (09), numbering should start again at 01.

How can I configure this in ERPNext?

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi

This is very much configurable. Please check document naming setting and consult with documentation as following;

https://docs.frappe.io/erpnext/user/manual/en/document-naming-settings
